items.title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison for rape and sexual assault
items.brief: Disgraced British comedian and actor Russell Brand was sentenced on Monday to 10 years and six months in prison after being convicted of raping a fan and assaulting three women during his showbiz career.

items.title: Cruise ship pianist rescued by fishermen after nine hours treading water in Pacific Ocean
items.brief: Two fishermen have rescued a man thought to have been treading water off the coast of California for nine hours after falling from a cruise ship .

items.title: Nvidia stock falls after probe into CEO’s affair with alleged foreign spy
items.brief: Nvidia shares fell roughly 7% on Monday after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having an extramarital affair and the company said it was investigating reports he was the “target of a foreign intelligence effort.”

items.title: Trump says ‘great dislike’ for Israel contributed to Republican midterm losses
items.brief: President Donald Trump said a “great dislike” for Israel was one of the reasons the Republicans lost in the midterm elections, along with the Iran war and the subsequent rise in gasoline prices.
